title: crataegus pruinosa var. rugosa
intro: Crataegus pruinosa var. rugosa, commonly known as a thorny shrub or small tree, is a variety of the Prickly Hawthorn plant, native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus pruinosa var. rugosa are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood flow and lowering blood pressure, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and organic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
